drums.description: Industrial techno with heavy EBM influences, The track features a distorted, saturated kick drum with a long sub-tail providing the rhythmic core, A metallic, percussive synth sequence runs in sixteenth notes, processed with a resonant band-pass filter, A gritty, overdriven bass synth mirrors the kick pattern with additional syncopated hits, High-frequency white noise bursts and mechanical foley sounds act as rhythmic accents, A dark, minor-key drone pad provides a constant atmospheric layer, The tempo is 135 BPM in the key of D minor, The arrangement is built on incremental layer additions and subtractive filtering sweeps, Sharp, digital claps with short decay occur on beats 2 and 4, A high-pitched, dissonant lead synth enters periodically with a sliding portamento effect Publish

bass.description: Industrial techno with heavy EBM influences, A distorted, overdriven kick drum provides a relentless rhythmic pulse at 135 BPM in the key of F minor, A resonant, metallic synth sequence with a high-pass filter sweep creates a rhythmic ostinato, Gritty, saturated bass stabs syncopate against the kick, Layered industrial percussion includes a sharp, digital snare with gated reverb and metallic hi-hats playing sixteenth-note patterns, A dark, atmospheric drone pad sits in the background with slow LFO modulation on the cutoff frequency, Distorted, spoken-word male vocals are processed with heavy compression and a short slapback delay, delivered in a rhythmic, monotone style Publish
